entries.heading: LIMITATION ON PAID LEAVE
ancestors: DIVISION A—KEEPING WORKERS PAID AND EMPLOYED, HEALTH CARE SYSTEM ENHANCEMENTS, AND ECONOMIC STABILIZATION
TITLE III—SUPPORTING AMERICA'S HEALTH CARE SYSTEM IN THE FIGHT AGAINST THE CORONAVIRUS
entries.text:
SEC. 3601. LIMITATION ON PAID LEAVE.

    Section 110(b)(2)(B) of the Family and Medical Leave Act of 1993 (as 
added by the Emergency Family and Medical Leave Expansion 
Act) is amended by striking clause (ii) and 
inserting the following:
                          ``(ii) Limitation.--An employer shall not be 
                      required to pay more than $200 per day and $10,000 
                      in the aggregate for each employee for paid leave 
                      under this section.''.
